name: Noshiro (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Noshiro city emblem in green, blue and light blue: a green stylised wave enclosing a blue and light blue swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Noshiro, a city in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 March 2006.
